CORE MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 27
   C. 31
   D. 17

2. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 10

3. Solve for x: x + 6 = 10. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 6
   D. 5

4. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 1, 6
   B. 1, 2, 3, 6
   C. 2, 4, 6
   D. 3, 6, 9

5. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 42
   C. 24
   D. 12

6. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 40

7. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 3
   C. 29
   D. 28

8. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

9. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 90
   C. 36
   D. 81

10. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 170
   C. 13
   D. 169

11. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 7
   C. 50
   D. 14

12. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 121
   C. 22
   D. 122

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — 25
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: c² = a² + b²
2. Substitute values: c² = 7² + 24²
3. c² = 49 + 576
4. c² = 625
5. c = 25
Final Answer: 25 cm
Mark reminder: method mark for Pythagoras; accuracy mark for hypotenuse

2. D — 10

3. B — 4
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: x = RHS − constant
2. Substitute values: x = 10 − 6
3. x = 4
Final Answer: x = 4
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

4. B — 1, 2, 3, 6

5. A — 36
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Area of square = side × side
2. Substitute values: Area = 6 × 6
3. Area = 36
Final Answer: 36 m²

7. D — 28
Working:

2. Substitute values: Product = 4 × 7
